scope: One general presentation and writing guide for every Workspace answer and web research answer, replacing topic-specific prompt rules, with more even spacing in answers. Diagrams under a heading no longer repeat their title and description on screen and keep a readable size.

keep: Program syntax, evidence citation, calculator wiring, safety-procedure order, answer validators and technical correction checks
replace: Topic-specific prompt rules (web framework, row security, payment webhooks, auth cookies, keyboard focus, bundles, schedules, listings) with general accuracy and evidence rules

architecture.reason: Same prompt functions and styles; only their wording changes.

cost.description: A shorter system prompt lowers input tokens. Reservation and settlement are unchanged.

tests.scope: The guide is general, asks for scannable non-speech writing, keeps layout rules, and invalid programs stay rejected.
Research answers keep evidence, citation and observation-time rules.
Rendered answers at phone to desktop widths, accessibility and diagram legibility.

rollout: API and website. Ask fresh prompts of many kinds on the live site and compare the layout.
rollback: Return API and website traffic to the previous revision and deployment; no database changes.
knownGaps: Real model answers written from the new guide are not yet observed.
Removed topic rules relied partly on the existing correction checks, which cover only some of those topics.

blockers: Required checks and live timing acceptance.
